_doc: Human-checks ledger (council-1012 spec 2.10). Things a script on the bundled Chromium cannot see. Version-keyed: the release tier refuses 'ready' while any item's lastTickedVersion is below the manifest.json version (or null). Tick an item by setting lastTickedVersion to the version you checked, plus by and date. gesture:true items form the NOT COVERED ON BRANDED CHROME count in every summary; a pass that only drives a stub can never retire one. engine: chrome = branded Chrome (the bundled Chromium is Chrome for Testing, not branded Chrome).

items.title: Load the unpacked or packed extension in branded Chrome: the worker starts, the popup opens, no warning on chrome://extensions
items.why: Lead decision 2026-10-12: the CfT leg is the bundled Chromium (build 151); branded Chrome is not loadable by flag or by script on this machine (rehearsals R6, R6b)

items.title: Press the toolbar icon: the popup opens in branded Chrome
items.why: action.onClicked and openPopup are unavailable to scripts without a user gesture; test-boot-smoke skips the press

items.title: The popup closes when focus leaves it and reopens fresh
items.why: close-on-blur is browser UI, not page behaviour

items.title: Permission bubble wording and flow: Allow on this site, revoke from chrome://extensions
items.why: permissions.request needs a trusted click and shows browser UI

items.title: Keyboard chords from a physical keyboard; Alt+Shift is the Windows language switch on Arabic/English layouts
items.why: OS key injection is rejected by the sandbox rules; input-switcher conflicts only show on a real layout

items.title: The side panel opens from the toolbar and its state matches the popup
items.why: sidePanel.open needs a gesture; the panel page is tested in a tab only

items.title: Tab and desktop capture pickers (tabCapture, desktopCapture, getDisplayMedia)
items.why: picker dialogs are browser UI

items.title: Native-messaging host prompt (helper bridge)
items.why: host registration and the prompt are OS and browser UI

items.title: Install from the Web Store listing
items.why: a store install cannot be scripted and is an outward action

items.title: Upgrade in place from the previous version with data kept
items.why: the migration path is only exercised against a real profile

items.title: mailto handoff to the default mail client
items.why: tests never click mailto: (an OS handler would open); the classifier only skips it

items.title: Real Jira and GitHub filing with real credentials
items.why: credentials are never read by the pipeline (S6); the mocks run on loopback

items.title: Downloads land in the real downloads folder with the expected names
items.why: suites use a per-run downloadsPath

items.title: Arabic RTL look in Thmanyah in branded Chrome
items.why: layout is asserted by script; the look is a human judgement, counted as not covered on branded Chrome

items.title: Screen-reader reading order and contrast judgement
items.why: axe finds rule violations, not whether it reads well

items.title: Real sites: strict CSP, single-page apps, iframes
items.why: fixtures cannot reproduce a live site; live-network tools the pipeline never runs

items.title: file:// and incognito toggles on chrome://extensions
items.why: chrome://extensions is browser UI

items.title: Multi-monitor and DPI 125 / 150 placement
items.why: window placement depends on the real display layout

items.title: Enterprise policy (managed schema) applied by a real policy
items.why: policy delivery is OS level

items.title: storage.sync across two signed-in profiles
items.why: Google sign-in sync exists only in branded Chrome
